skill_updates.change: pre-scan every lane brief for the remote-write marker list before dispatch: the scan is a SUBSTRING match and the list includes 'publish', so ordinary prose ('published') refuses the dispatch with ERR_LANE_REMOTE_WRITE_NOT_AUTHORIZED. Satisfy the gate by naming the admitted delivery WorkOrder (a bare WO- token) in the brief, never by rewording around the scanner.

when the lane pool's rank-1 arm is the same model as the writer, the round has no SoD: pin the mandated checker with --require-arm <provider>/<model> plus --force-rank <n> (and --allow-human-home-transport when the arm is marked REACHABLE_VIA_HUMAN_HOME_TRANSPORT), record required-vs-served in the receipt, and never edit the registry to align it with the mandate.

compile-first rule: a command envelope's own compiler verdict (e.g. compiler_verdict_here: PROMPT_COMPILE_BLOCKED) is a claim about the machine that produced the envelope. Locate a same-version compiler bundle locally and run lint/activation/acceptance/compile before reporting a blocker.

require a paired mutation for every check in a round's self-check, and report how many mutations fired: a detector that cannot fail is not evidence. Also verify a release artefact's SELF-DECLARED identity (its own header/provenance fields), not only its digest.

new_round_assets: checks/r6_doc_identity_check.py (document-identity detector with paired mutations; 7 checks / 7 mutations)
checks/release_readback.py (fresh HTTPS release readback: tag identity, 7 assets, served ZIP recomputation, archive member audit)
checks/route_check.py (GSTACK named-method registry snapshot + per-flow route decision + negative control)
build_evidence_pack.py (evidence pack generator that derives every count from artefacts on disk)
publish/_askpass.cmd + publish/_askpass.py (non-echoing credential helper; the PAT is never in argv, logs, the remote URL, a commit or the evidence)

prior_open_owner_items_now_concretely_re: lane marker-scan semantics (substring match refuses ordinary prose) -> satisfy by citing the delivery WorkOrder; the marker list was read from source, not guessed
canonical SoD route repair (PLAN vs VERIFY_SECURITY collision) -> resolved at dispatch time with rank+arm pinning and a receipt that records required vs served
